questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct? 18 + 6 - 6 ÷ 3 × 3 = 6
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

18 + 6 - 6 ÷ 3 × 3 = 6
questions.solution:
i) 18 × 6 - 6 ÷ 3 + 3 = 108 - 2 + 3 = 109 ≠ 6

ii) 18 ÷ 6 - 6 + 3 × 3 = 3 - 6 + 9 = 6

iii) 18 - 6 + 6 ÷ 3 × 3 = 18 ≠ 6

iv) 18 + 6 ÷ 6 - 3 × 3 = 10 ≠ 6

Hence, + and ÷ should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct.

questions.question: 10 years ago, a father’s age was \(3\frac{1}{2}\) times that of his son, and 10 years from now, the father’s age will be \(2\frac{1}{4}\) times that of the son. What will be the sum of the ages of the father and the son at present?
questions.questionHtml: 10 years ago, a father’s age was \(3\frac{1}{2}\) times that of his son, and 10 years from now, the father’s age will be \(2\frac{1}{4}\) times that of the son. What will be the sum of the ages of the father and the son at present?
questions.solution:
Current age of Father = F;

Current age of  Son = S

Ten years ago

(F - 10) = 3.5 (S - 10)

F = 3.5S - 35 + 10

3.5S - F = 25 - (i)

Ten years hence

F + 10 = 2.25 (S + 10)

F - 2.25S = 22.5 - 10

F - 2.25S = 12.5 i.e.2F - 4.5S = 25 (ii)

That implies that

3.5 S - F = 2F - 4.5S

8S = 3F

Multiplying (i) by 3

10.5S - 3F = 75         

10.5S - 8S = 75
2.5 S = 75

S = 30;

Hence 3F = 240,

F = 80

Hence, sum of ages of father and son will be 80 + 30 = 110.

questions.question: If [8(x + y) 3 – 27(x – y) 3 ] ÷ (5y – x) = Ax 2 + Bxy + Cy 2 , then the value of (A + B + C) is:

questions.solution:
Short trick∶

Put x = y = 1 in [8(x + y)3 – 27(x – y)3] ÷ (5y – x) = Ax2 + Bxy + Cy2 

∴ A + B + C = 16

Detailed Solution∶

⇒ [8(x + y)3 – 27(x - y)3] ÷ (5y - x) = Ax2 + Bxy + Cy2

⇒ [{2(x + y)}3 – {3(x – y)}3] ÷ (5y – x) = Ax2 + Bxy + Cy2

⇒ {2(x + y)} – {3(x – y)} [{2(x + y)}2 + 2(x + y)3(x – y) + {3(x – y)}2] ÷ (5y – x) = Ax2 + Bxy + Cy2

⇒ (5y – x) [4x2 + 4y2 + 8xy + 6x2 – 6y2 + 9x2 + 9y2 – 18xy] ÷ (5y – x) = Ax2 + Bxy + Cy2

⇒ 19x2 – 10xy + 7y2 = Ax2 + Bxy + Cy2

On comparing

⇒ A = 19, B = -10 and C = 7

⇒ (A + B + C) = 19 + 7 – 10 = 16

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum in \(2\frac{1}{2}\) years at 10% p.a., interest compounded yearly, is Rs. 1,623. The sum is:
questions.questionHtml: The compound interest on a certain sum in \(2\frac{1}{2}\) years at 10% p.a., interest compounded yearly, is Rs. 1,623. The sum is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Compound Interest, C.I. = Rs. 1623

Rate of Interest, R = 10 percent

Time = \(2\frac{1}{2}{\rm{\;Years}}\)

Formula Used:

When interest is compounded annually but the time is in fraction (suppose time = \({\rm{n}}\frac{{\rm{a}}}{{\rm{b}}}\) years), then,

\({\rm{A}} = {\rm{P}}{\left( {1 + \frac{{\rm{R}}}{{100}}} \right)^{\rm{n}}}\left( {\frac{{100 + \left( {\frac{{\rm{a}}}{{\rm{b}}}} \right) × {\rm{R}}}}{{100}}{\rm{\;}}} \right)\)

where A =Amount

P = Principal,

R = Rate of Interest,

n = Whole part of Time

a, b = Numerator and Denominator of the fraction part of the time.

Calculation:

Let the Principal be P.

So, the Amount, 

\({\rm{A}} = {\rm{P}}{\left( {1 + \frac{{\rm{R}}}{{100}}} \right)^{\rm{n}}}\left( {\frac{{100 + \left( {\frac{{\rm{a}}}{{\rm{b}}}} \right) × {\rm{R}}}}{{100}}{\rm{\;}}} \right)\)

\( \Rightarrow {\rm{A}} = {\rm{P}}{\left( {1 + \frac{{10}}{{100}}} \right)^2}\left( {\frac{{100 + \left( {\frac{1}{2}} \right) × 10}}{{100}}{\rm{\;}}} \right)\)

⇒ A = P × (11/10)2 × (21/20)

⇒ A = P × (121/100) 

Now, Compound Interest = Amount – Principal

⇒ 1623 = P × (121/100) × (21/20) – P

⇒ 1623 = P × {(2541/2000) – 1}

⇒ 1623 = P × (2541 – 2000)/2000

⇒ 1623 = P × 541/2000

⇒ P = 1623 × 2000/541

⇒ P = 6,000

∴ The Principal is Rs. 6,000

questions.question: If x is subtracted from each of 23, 39, 32 and 56, the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 4) and (3x + 1)?
questions.questionHtml: If x is subtracted from each of 23, 39, 32 and 56, the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 4) and (3x + 1)?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

If x is subtracted from a, b, c, d to make them proportional, then x = (ad − bc) ÷ ((a + d) − (b + c)).

Here, a = 23, b = 39, c = 32, d = 56.

x = (23 × 56 − 39 × 32) ÷ ((23 + 56) − (39 + 32)) = (1288 − 1248) ÷ (79 − 71) = 40 ÷ 8 = 5.

First number = x + 4 = 5 + 4 = 9, Second number = 3x + 1 = 3(5) + 1 = 16.

Mean proportional = √(9 × 16) = √144 = 12.

∴ The correct answer is 12.

Alternate Method

Given:

Numbers: 23, 39, 32, and 56.

x is subtracted from each number to make them proportional.

We need to find the mean proportional between (x + 4) and (3x + 1).

Formula Used:

If four numbers a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a ÷ b = c ÷ d.

Mean proportional between p and q = √(p × q)

Calculations:

⇒ (23 − x) ÷ (39 − x) = (32 − x) ÷ (56 − x)

⇒ (23 − x)(56 − x) = (32 − x)(39 − x)

⇒ 1288 − 56x − 23x + x2 = 1248 − 39x − 32x + x2

⇒ 1288 − 79x = 1248 − 71x

⇒ 1288 − 1248 = 79x − 71x

⇒ 40 = 8x

⇒ x = 5

Now, substitute x = 5 in the expressions (x + 4) and (3x + 1):

⇒ x + 4 = 5 + 4 = 9

⇒ 3x + 1 = 3(5) + 1 = 16

⇒ Mean proportional = √(9 × 16)

⇒ Mean proportional = √144 = 12

∴ The correct answer is 12.

Additional Information

Mean Proportional

For two positive numbers a and b, the mean proportional is the square root of their product: √(a × b).

Third Proportional

For two given numbers a and b, the third proportional c satisfies the relation a : b = b : c, giving c = b2 ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d satisfies a : b = c : d, which simplifies to d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a ÷ b = c ÷ d, then according to this rule, (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = (c + d) ÷ (c − d).

questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. That sort of pollution, which is also widespread in other south east Asian nations, regularly kills wildlife like whales and turtles that ingest the waste.

B. Environmental groups have tagged the Philippines as one of the world's biggest ocean polluters due to its reliance on single-use plastic.

C. In Thailand also, a whale died last year after swallowing more than 80 plastic bags.

D. In the latest case, a whale with 40 kilos of plastic trash in its stomach died on Saturday in southern Philippines where it was stranded a day earlier.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3.

The first statement should be B i.e 'Environmental groups have tagged the Philippines as one of the world's biggest ocean polluters due to its reliance on single-use plastic.' It gives an introduction of what is being talked about in the following statements.

After B, it should be A i.e 'That sort of pollution, which is also widespread in other southeast Asian nations, regularly kills wildlife like whales and turtles that ingest the waste.' In the previous statement, ocean pollution was mentioned so, B gives the consequences of this pollution.

After A, it should be D as it talks about a case in the Philippines and after D, it should be C as it talks about a case in Thailand.

The correct order is BADC.

So, options 1,2 and 4 are incorrect.
